business.name: KorTech Service

physicalLocations.note: The ONLY physical location. Every other city on the site is a service area, not a branch.

contact.phoneFormatNote: Always bare digits with dashes, no parentheses. Matches LOCAL_CITATIONS.md.

business.serviceAreaNote: SERVICE AREAS ONLY. Never imply a branch, office, storefront, staff or address in any of these beyond Charlotte.

leadGoals.note: Success is a contacted lead, not a pageview. Rank-and-CTR work should be judged against whether it plausibly produces calls/texts.

schemaPolicy.aggregateRating: NOT permitted in our own LocalBusiness/Organization schema. Google-sourced rating stays visible on-page with attribution only.
schemaPolicy.review: No Review nodes in our own schema.
schemaPolicy.faqPage: Google retired FAQ rich results in May 2026. Existing FAQPage JSON-LD is kept as semantic markup for other consumers - do not add more to chase Google rich results.
schemaPolicy.howTo: Do not add to chase Google rich results.

contentPolicy.wordCount: No target. Google has no preferred word count. Length follows the question being answered.
contentPolicy.filler: Never add text purely to increase length.

routingFreeze.reason: GSC validation for Soft 404 and Page with redirect restarted 2026-09-14 and is still recrawling.

gsc.role: GROUND TRUTH. Real impressions/clicks/position for this site. Outranks any third-party estimate.

ga4.role: Engagement and conversion context. Not yet populated.

semrush.role: Volume, KD, intent, competitor and backlink gap enrichment.

meta.note: Internal analytics workspace. Never deployed - dist/ is FTP-synced to production and this directory lies outside Vite's publicDir (verified with a canary file). Exported data files and any credentials are gitignored.
